# NY Daily News

> > New York's hometown newspaper serving the five boroughs with breaking news, sports, entertainment, and local community coverage since 1919.

The NY Daily News is one of New York City's major daily newspapers, providing comprehensive coverage of local news, politics, crime, sports, and culture across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island. The site also offers classifieds and advertising services for the New York metropolitan area.
